WITH
            input_dates AS (
                SELECT
                    DATE('2025-06-05')                    AS input_date,
                    MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
                FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
                WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-05')
                  AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
                  AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
            ),
        
            listed_re_mp AS (
                SELECT business_date, 
                       model_portfolio,
                       model_portfolio_name 
                FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten 
                WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
                  AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
                  AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
                  AND (
                              InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                          AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                          AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                          AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                          AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                          OR model_portfolio IN ('')
                       )
                  AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                        SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates 
                        UNION 
                        SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
                      )
            ),
        
            perf_data AS (
                SELECT
                    perf.model_portfolio_id,
                    perf.abor_security_id,
                    perf.abor_security_number,
                    MAX(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates) 
                                THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency 
                        END) AS market_value_qc_start,
                    MAX(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates) 
                                THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency 
                        END) AS market_value_qc_end,
        			MAX(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates) 
                                THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency 
                        END) AS market_value_pc_start,
                    MAX(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates) 
                                THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency 
                        END) AS market_value_pc_end,
                    asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                    asset.security_name,
                    asset.bloomberg_code,
                    mp.model_portfolio
                FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
                INNER JOIN listed_re_mp mp
                        ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
                       AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
                LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
                       ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
                      AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
                      AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
                WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                        SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates 
                        UNION 
                        SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
                      )
                  AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit', 'Right')
                GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id, 
                         perf.abor_security_id, 
                         perf.abor_security_number, 
                         mp.model_portfolio,
                         asset.bloomberg_unique_id, 
                         asset.security_name, 
                         asset.bloomberg_code
            )
        
        SELECT
            (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
            perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
            perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
            perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
            perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
            perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
            perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",
            perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",
        	perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency  AS "Total PnL QC",
        	perf_data.market_value_pc_start							AS "Total Market Value PC Start",
        	perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow PC",
        	perf_data.market_value_pc_end							AS "Total Market Value PC End",
            perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
        	perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
        FROM perf_data
        INNER JOIN performance.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
                ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio 
               AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
               AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-06-05')
        ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 perf_data.bloomberg_code

SELECT "business_date", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "ultimate_parent_party_name", "issuer_name", "parent_security_type_name", "security_type_name", "security_name", "total_market_value_pc", "security_name_clean", "combined_entity_name_original", "combined_entity_name_clean", "department_sorted"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1 as investment_structure_level_01,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2 as investment_structure_level_02,
		uppcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name as issuer_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name /*as "Exposure Via"*/,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name,
		sum( lt.total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
	from (
		select *
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
		where
			id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
			and id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
				  'MIN1000042'
				, 'NPTESTA'
				, 'NPTESTB'
				, 'PMIEMELTCS'
				, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
				, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
				, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
			) 
			and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough ) -- filter only for the data as of the latest business date
	) lt
	left join asset.enterprise_security /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite*/ secc
	on
		lt.enterprise_security_id = secc.enterprise_security_id
		and lt.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join party.enterprise_party /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite*/ pcc
	on
		secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
		and pcc.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join party.enterprise_party /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite*/ uppcc
	on
		pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id = uppcc.enterprise_party_id
		and uppcc.business_date = pcc.business_date
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
	on
		lt.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	group by
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2,
		uppcc.epm_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name
), lt_final as (
	select
		  *
		, coalesce( ultimate_parent_party_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( issuer_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( security_name, '' ) as combined_entity_name_original
		, coalesce( ultimate_parent_party_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( issuer_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( security_name_clean, '' ) as combined_entity_name_clean
		, case
			when investment_structure_level_01 in ( 'Cash for benefits', 'Accounts' ) then '7. Cash for Benefits and Residual Cash'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Total Fund Management' then '1. Total Fund Management'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' then '2. Capital Markets & Factor Investing'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Active Equities' then '3. Active Equities'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Credit Investments' then '4. Credit Investments'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Private Equity' then '5. Private Equity'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Real Assets' then '6. Real Assets'
	  	  end department_sorted
	from (
		select
			  *
			, case
				when regexp_like( lower( security_type_name ), '.*\b(leg|swap|swaptions|option|future|contract|deposit|paper|collateralized|bond|repo|revrepo|buyselback|selbuyback)\b.*' ) then regexp_replace( security_name, '[0-9]', '' )
				else security_name
			  end security_name_clean
		from 
			lt_base
	)
)
select * from lt_final) AS "holdings_search_holdings_lookthrough"

'Public Holdings in Private SEG' WHEN "Model Portfolio Code" = 'MPR1000279' THEN 'Public Holdings in Private SEG' WHEN "Model Portfolio Code" = 'MPR1000328' THEN 'Public Holdings in Private SEG' WHEN "Model Portfolio Code" = 'MPAREDP' THEN 'Public Holdings in Private SEG' WHEN "Model Portfolio Code" = 'MPARELE' THEN 'Public Holdings in Private SEG' WHEN "Model Portfolio Code" = 'MPRSBE0' THEN 'Public Holdings in Private SEG' ELSE 'Other' END AS "Portfolio", "Business Date" + 9 * interval '1' MONTH AS "Fiscal Year", CASE WHEN "Net Sell PC" < 0 THEN "Gross Purchase PC" + "Net Sell PC" ELSE "Gross Purchase PC" END AS "Fixed Gross Purchase PC", CASE WHEN "Net Sell PC" > 0 THEN "Net Sell PC" ELSE 0 END AS "Fixed Net Sell PC"
FROM (WITH
    listed_ra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND model_portfolio IN (
				'RIPREI1A','RIPREI2A','RIPREI1E','RIPREI2E',								-- Listed RE
				'MPINFRA1D','MPINFRA2D','MPINFRA1E','MPINLCP1D',							-- Listed Infra
				'MPSEG1D','MPSEG1E',														-- Listed SEG
				'MIN1000104','MINELET','MINEON9','MINADP9','MINDNY9','MINCLNX',				-- Public Holidings in Private Infra
				'MPAR100040','MPAR100041','MPAR100043','MPAR100053','MPR1000200','MPR1000279','MPR1000328','MPAREDP','MPARELE','MPRSBE0'	-- Public Holidings in Private SEG
              )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_trans AS (
        SELECT trans.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
                    ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_finance_trans AS (
        SELECT fin.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, fin.finance_transaction_index
                    ORDER BY fin.extract_time DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        WHERE fin.finance_scheme LIKE '%EQTY%'
          AND fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
          AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'
          AND fin.gl_account_name NOT LIKE '%DUE%'
          AND fin.booking_type != 'Payment reconciliation'
    ),
    trans AS (
        SELECT
            trans.trade_date                        AS business_date,
            trans.model_portfolio_id                AS model_portfolio_id,
            sec.bloomberg_unique_id                 AS bb_unique_id,
            CASE
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Sell ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Sell Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%REALIZED%' THEN 'Sell GL'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy','Exchange Offer') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Net Purchase'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Purchase Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%DIVIDEND INC%' THEN 'Gross Dividend'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TAX EXP%' THEN 'Dividend Taxes'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'CapRd ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%REALIZED CURR GL%' THEN 'CapRd GL'
                ELSE 'unmapped'
            END                                     AS transaction_type,            
            fin.credit_amount_portfolio_currency-fin.debit_amount_portfolio_currency     AS total_amount_pc,
            fin.credit_amount_quotation_currency-fin.debit_amount_quotation_currency     AS total_amount_qc
            FROM latest_trans trans
            INNER JOIN latest_finance_trans fin
                ON trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key = fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key
            INNER JOIN listed_ra_mp mp
                ON trans.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND trans.trade_date = mp.business_date
            LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
               ON CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
              AND trans.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
            WHERE trans.rn = 1
            AND fin.rn = 1     
    ),
    aggregated_trans AS (
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_pc
        FROM trans 
        WHERE transaction_type != 'unmapped'
        GROUP BY business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id     
    ),
    calculated_trans AS(
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
            net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc AS gross_purchase_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc AS net_sell_pc,
            cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS total_cap_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc + net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc + cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS net_cap_bal_pc
        FROM aggregated_trans
    )

SELECT
    CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE)                                              AS "Business Date",
    regional_classification_name                                                     AS "DM/EM",
    CASE WHEN mp.model_portfolio_id IN ('RIPREI1A','RIPREI2A','RIPREI1E','RIPREI2E') 
        THEN sec_ent.cppib_sector_classification_name_4
        ELSE sec_ent.cppib_sector_classification_name_2
    END                                                                              AS "Sector",
    sec.bloomberg_unique_id                                                          AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    TRIM(REPLACE(sec.bloomberg_cd, sec.sec_typ_lvl1_nm, ''))                         AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    mp.model_portfolio_name                                                          AS "Model Portfolio Name",
    mp.model_portfolio_id                                                            AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    sec.sec_nm                                                                       AS "Security Name - Current",
    currency1.currency_name                                                          AS "Quoted Currency Name",
    country.country_name                                                             AS "Country of Exposure Name - Current",
    currency2.currency_name                                                          AS "Currency of Exposure Name - Current",
    holding.balance_nominal_number                                                   AS "Balance Nominal/Number",
    holding.dirty_value_total_quotation_currency                                     AS "Total Market Value QC",
    holding.dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency                                     AS "Total Market Value PC",
    calc.gross_purchase_pc                                                           AS "Gross Purchase PC",
    calc.net_sell_pc                                                                 AS "Net Sell PC",
    calc.total_cap_pc                                                                AS "Total Capital PC",
    COALESCE(calc.net_cap_bal_pc,0)                                                  AS "Net Capital Balance PC"
FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main holding
INNER JOIN listed_ra_mp invstr
        ON holding.model_portfolio_id = invstr.model_portfolio
       AND holding.business_date = invstr.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
       ON holding.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
      AND holding.business_date = mp.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
       ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications sec_ent
       ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec_ent.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec_ent.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes currency1
       ON holding.quotation_currency_code = currency1.currency_code
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = currency1.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes currency2
       ON sec_ent.cppib_currency_of_exposure_code = currency2.currency_code
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = currency2.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes country
       ON sec_ent.cppib_country_of_exposure_code = country.country_code
      AND country.business_date = CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE)
LEFT JOIN calculated_trans calc
       ON calc.bb_unique_id = sec.bloomberg_unique_id 
      AND calc.business_date = holding.business_date
      AND calc.model_portfolio_id = holding.model_portfolio_id
WHERE CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
  AND holding.cppib_sec_id IS NOT NULL
  AND holding.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit', 'Right')
ORDER BY holding.business_date DESC,
         sec.bloomberg_unique_id) AS "LRA Holdings - Whitelisting"

		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc

		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc

		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name

		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name

		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0

			, sum(

					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage

		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code

		, case

			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'

			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'

			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base

		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS

			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)
select * from lt_final_agg) AS "finsights_holdings_lookthrough"

WITH

        SELECT
            3 AS min_active_stage_number,
            4 AS min_on_hold_stage_number,
            '2024-06-30' AS opp_added_cutoff_date
    ),
    MAX_DATES AS (
        SELECT
            (SELECT MAX(date) FROM dealcloud_ci_opportunity_extract) AS max_opp_date,
            (SELECT MAX(date) FROM dealcloud_ci_restricted_opportunity_extract) AS max_rest_date
    )
SELECT
    'CI' AS inv_department,
    o.cppib_group AS inv_group,
    o.cppib_sub_group_strategy AS inv_strategy,
    o.cppib_sub_group_strategy AS id_signal,
    o.cppib_office,
    o.industry_vertical,
    o.gics_sector,
    o.private_vs_public,
    o.risk_rating,
    o.geographic_focus_ci AS issuer_region,
    o.geographic_focus_ci AS issuer_developed_or_emerging,
    o.permissions_flag AS issuer_ethical_wall,
    o.country_of_exposure AS issuer_country_of_exposure,
    o.country_of_exposure AS currency_of_exposure,
    o.deal_lead,
    o.deal_team,
    'CPPIB' AS organization,
    'Asset' AS level
FROM
    dealcloud_ci_opportunity_extract o
    CROSS JOIN PARAMS p
    CROSS JOIN MAX_DATES d
WHERE
    o.date = d.max_opp_date
    AND o.date_added > DATE(p.opp_added_cutoff_date)
    AND (
        o.status = 'Closed'
        OR (
            o.status IN ('Active')
            AND CAST(SUBSTR(o.stage, 1, 1) AS INTEGER) >= p.min_active_stage_number
        )
        OR (
            o.status IN ('On Hold')
            AND CAST(SUBSTR(o.stage, 1, 1) AS INTEGER) >= p.min_on_hold_stage_number
        )
    )

  		analytic_value,

  exp_shrt_1yr as (

  		node,
  		department,
  		strategy,
  		program,
  		sub_program,
  		model_portfolio,
  		analytic_value,

  		analytic_type,

  	where analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_1YR'
  		and hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
  		and confidence_level = 0.95
  ),
  rm_pv as (
  	select node_level,
  		node,
  		department,
  		strategy,
  		program,
  		sub_program,
  		model_portfolio,
  		analytic_value,
  		business_date,
  		'RM_PV' as analytic_type,

  		'' as position_key
  	from risk_prod.rmv_analytics

  		model_portfolio,

  	select *

SELECT * FROM (WITH params AS (
            SELECT from_iso8601_date( NULL ) AS query_date
        ),
             adjusted_date AS (
                 SELECT
                     query_date,
                     CASE
                         WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
                         WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
                         ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
                         END AS business_date
                 FROM params
             ),
             account_mapping_query AS (
                 SELECT
                     date_format(pam.as_of_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
                     pam.mx_portfolio_id AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
                     pam.bbg_pfolio_id AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
                     pam.model_portfolio AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
                     pam.sst_account AS SST_ACCOUNT
                 FROM reference.model_portfolio_account_mapping pam
                 WHERE pam.as_of_date BETWEEN (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '7' day
                           AND (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '1' day
             ),
             unioned_data AS (
                 select COALESCE(BUSINESS_DATE, '') as BUSINESS_DATE,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(MUREX_PORTOFOLIO), '') as MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(BBG_ACCOUNT), '') as BBG_ACCOUNT,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(SCD_ACCOUNT), '') as SCD_ACCOUNT,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(SST_ACCOUNT), '') as SST_ACCOUNT
                 FROM account_mapping_query

                 UNION

                 SELECT
                     scd.business_date AS BUSINESS_DATE,
                     '' AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
                     '' AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
                     COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '') AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
                     COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '') AS SST_ACCOUNT
                 FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio scd
                 WHERE CAST(scd.business_date AS DATE) BETWEEN (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '7' day
                     AND (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '1' day
                   and NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1
                     FROM account_mapping_query fq
                     WHERE COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SCD_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '')
                       AND COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SST_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '')
                 )
             ),
             daily_counts AS (
                 SELECT business_date, COUNT(*) AS record_count
                 FROM unioned_data
                 GROUP BY business_date
             ),
             average_count AS (
                 SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count
                 FROM daily_counts
             )
        SELECT cast(avg_count as varchar) FROM average_count) T LIMIT 0

/* QuickSight 9f359145-7cd7-4647-b2da-138d616a64e8 */
SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "business_date_int", "year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (with asset_class_base as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, node_name as pbor_node_name
		, "level" as split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_lc' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%_qtd_%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%_3m_%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%_fytd_%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%_1y_roll_%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%_4yp_%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%_5y_roll_%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, node_name 
			, "level"
			, time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where
			dataset_id = 'ASSETCL_CMB'
			and periods_per_year = 12
			and "level" = 1
			and node_name != 'Excluded' -- Per Michael Brown from Performance team, the Excluded node should be excluded from reporting
	) pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc

			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc

			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc

	) unpivot ( metric, value )
), asset_class_clean as (
	select
		  asset_class_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, cast( format( '%1$tY%1$tm%1$td', business_date ) as int ) as business_date_int
		, date_format( business_date, '%Y-%m' ) as year_month
		--, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', calendar_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from

/* cppi::413d3841b3c57f32f465dbeff1a4d11b51e1913c4a49c07865c9d9005be37c22 */
WITH
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
      FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM quarter_end_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, quarter_end_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, quarter_end_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM quarter_end
           )
),
offsets AS (
     SELECT SEQUENCE(0, 4 * 30 - 1) AS quarter_offsets
),
quarters AS (
     SELECT x,
            DATE_ADD('quarter', -x, current_fq_start) AS start_date
       FROM offsets
 CROSS JOIN UNNEST(quarter_offsets) AS t(x)

		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM

	WHERE

) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM reference.scd_securities

)
SELECT  a.*, b.*, c.*, d.*, e.*, g.*, l.*, '2025-05-26' as business_date,
(case when g.cppib_country_of_exposure_code is not null then g.cppib_country_of_exposure_code
      when l.country_of_exposure_code is not null then l.country_of_exposure_code
      when a.exposure_country_code is not null then a.exposure_country_code
      else null end) as moodys_exposure_country_code
from
  (
	select 
	   ss.model_portfolio_id as id_model_portfolio,
	   ss.abor_security_type_name as security_type_name,
	   ss.security_group_name,
	   ss.scd_holding_key_id as id_source_holding,
	   s.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_department_name,
	   ref.id_cppib_party as id_counterparty,
	   ss.abor_security_name as security_name,
	   ss.abor_security_number as security_no,
	   ss.cppib_sec_id as cppib_sec_id,
	   null as id_enterprise_holding,
	   ref.party_name as issuer_name,
	   sec.abor_country_id as country_code,
	   sec.country_of_exposure_code as exposure_country_code,
	   sec.currency_of_exposure_code as exposure_currency_code,
	   sec.country_of_exposure_name as exposure_country_name,
	   sec.currency_of_exposure_name as exposure_currency_name,
	   ss.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency as balance_cost_value_qc,
	   ss.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency as balance_cost_value_pc,
	   ss.balance_book_value_quotation_currency as balance_book_value_qc,
	   ss.clean_price * ss.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as clean_price_pc,
	   cast(ss.clean_price as DECIMAL(18,2)) as clean_price_qc,
	   ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as clean_value_qc,
	   ss.clean_value_portfolio_currency as clean_value_pc,
	   ss.balance_nominal_number as balance_nominal,
	   ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as current_nominal,
	   ss.clean_value_portfolio_currency as current_nominal_pc,
	   '48' as instrument_type_code,
	   ss.abor_instrument_type as instrument_type_name,
	   ss.quotation_currency_code as currency,
	   ss.security_group_id as security_group_code,
	   0.0 as abacus_accrued_interest_pc,
	   0.0 as abacus_accrued_interest_qc,
	   ss.quotation_currency_code as current_notional_currency,
	   ss.quotation_currency_code as market_value_currency,
	   ss.abor_security_type_id as security_type_code
	from holdings.scd_holdings_main ss
	left join RankedSecurities sec 
		on ss.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
	left join reference.scd_party_issuer ref
	    on sec.abor_issuer_id = ref.party_id
	    and ss.business_date = ref.business_date
	left join performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten  s
		on ss.model_portfolio_id = s.model_portfolio
		and ss.business_date = s.business_date
	where ss.business_date = '2025-05-26'

   (select

      where business_date = date'2025-05-26'

         on a.exposure_currency_code = b.currency_code

      from finance_accounting.model_portfolios
      where business_date = date'2025-05-26'

         on a.id_model_portfolio = c.id_model_portfolio

left join

   (select

      from asset.asset_security_identifiers
      where business_date = date'2025-05-26'

      where business_date = date'2025-05-26'

         on d.cppib_party_id = e.cppib_party_id

  (select

      from party.party_enterprise_classification

   (select distinct

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Description:
-- This query grabs data from ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_data_warehouse_staging,
-- joins it to ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference data, and applies some
-- light business rules from the BRD related to deployment_disposition, 
-- probability_of_close, capital_usage_component, and transaction_cash_flow_type.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.0.0 | 2025-04-28 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Initial version of query
-- v1.0.1 | 2025-05-12 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Edited source data columns based on business requirements.
-- v1.0.2 | 2025-05-28 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Added translation from True/False to Y/N for internal_transfer_y_n
-- v1.0.3 | 2025-05-29 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Remove the max timestamp logic and added run_id injection parameter
-- v1.0.4 | 2025-06-04 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Fixed probability_of_close which did not have the correct logic
--   because the BRD was using incorrect wording (opportunities/deals
--   in the data warehouse close, they don't exit)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

SELECT
  --------------------------------------
  -- metadata
  --------------------------------------
  staging.source,
  staging.business_date,
  staging.run_id,
  staging.extract_timestamp,
  staging.extract_timestamp_iso_8601,
  staging.extract_timestamp_time_zone,
  --------------------------------------
  -- identifiers
  --------------------------------------
  staging.account_id,
  reference.scd_id,
  reference.security_identifier,
  reference.issuer_identifier,
  reference.cppib_security_id,
  reference.cppib_entity_id,
  staging.source_data_id,
  reference.sentry_security_id,
  reference.sentry_issuer_id,
  reference.model_portfolio_code,
  reference.deal_id,
  reference.upstream_pipeline_number,
  --------------------------------------
  -- other reference
  --------------------------------------
  reference.security_name,
  reference.strategy,
  reference.sub_strategy,
  reference.project_name,
  reference.investment_name,
  reference.country_of_exposure,
  reference.private_vs_public,
  reference.asset_category,
  reference.seniority,
  reference.risk_rating,
  reference.investment_department_id,
  reference.investment_status,
  reference.investment_lifecycle,
  reference.sector,
  reference.maturity_date AS maturity_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- other staging
  --------------------------------------
  staging.funding_currency,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm >= 0 THEN 'Deployment'
    ELSE 'Disposition'
  END AS deployment_disposition,
  COALESCE(staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm, 0) * (COALESCE(staging.probability_of_close, 0) / 100.0) AS probability_weighted_investment_amount_local,
  staging.funded_amount,
  staging.quantity_net,
  staging.market_value,
  staging.portfolio_name,
  staging.sentry_security_type,
  staging.price_multiplier,
  staging.quantity_multiplier,
  staging.debt_factor,
  staging.model_portfolio_id,
  --------------------------------------
  -- fixed-values specified in BRD
  --------------------------------------
  CASE
    WHEN TRY_CAST(staging.expected_funding_date AS DATE)
       > TRY_CAST(staging.business_date         AS DATE)
    THEN COALESCE(staging.probability_of_close, 80)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS probability_of_close,
  'Binding' AS binding,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Net Income and Expenses'
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n IS NOT NULL THEN 'Net Purchases and Sales'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS capital_usage_component,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.internal_transfer_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Internal Transfer'
    WHEN reference.asset_category = 'Aggregate Projection Shell' THEN 'Aggregate Drawdown/Distribution Projection'
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Income Only'
    ELSE 'Investment Funding/Distribution'
  END AS transaction_cash_flow_type,
  'Y' AS send_to_treasury_y_n,
  --------------------------------------
  -- 'expected'-related fields
  --------------------------------------
  staging.expected_funding_date,
  staging.expected_trade_date,
  staging.expected_exit_price,
  staging.expected_exit_probability,
  staging.expected_exit_date,
  staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm,
  --------------------------------------
  -- will be calculated by python code
  --------------------------------------
  null AS unadjusted_exit_projection,
  --------------------------------------
  -- created by and updated by fields
  --------------------------------------
  staging.last_updated_by,
  staging.last_updated_date,
  staging.created_by_user_group,
  staging.created_by,
  staging.date_updated,
  --------------------------------------
  -- source business dates
  --------------------------------------
  staging.business_date AS staging_src_business_date,
  reference.business_date AS reference_src_business_date,
  staging.sentry_ledger_projections_src_business_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- comment and error
  --------------------------------------
  staging.comment,
  staging.error,
  --------------------------------------
  -- null on purpose (from requirements)
  --------------------------------------
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount,
  NULL AS fo_comments,
  NULL AS pec_recusals,
  NULL AS pec_pipeline_y_n,
  NULL AS fx_spot,
  NULL AS full_amt_cad_mm,
  NULL AS ticket_number,
  NULL AS rejected_deals_reason,
  --------------------------------------
  -- investigate these
  --------------------------------------
  -- staging.investment_program
  -- reference.investment_strategy
  -- reference.investment_group
  -- staging.tfm_inv_sub_strategy
  --------------------------------------
  -- dw-specific fields
  --------------------------------------
  CASE 
    WHEN staging.internal_transfer_y_n = 'True' THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS internal_transfer_y_n,
  staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n,
  --------------------------------------
  -- helpful debug information
  --------------------------------------
  'ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_data_warehouse_staging, ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference' AS data_sources_list,
  'n' AS ignore_y_n
  --------------------------------------
FROM
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_data_warehouse_staging staging
LEFT JOIN
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference reference
ON
  staging.security_identifier = reference.security_identifier
  AND reference.run_id = 'fbde7252-f852-4b32-8e7b-a78224c0e5b7'
WHERE
  staging.run_id = 'fbde7252-f852-4b32-8e7b-a78224c0e5b7'

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Description:
-- This query grabs data from ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_data_warehouse_staging,
-- joins it to ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference data, and applies some
-- light business rules from the BRD related to deployment_disposition, 
-- probability_of_close, capital_usage_component, and transaction_cash_flow_type.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.0.0 | 2025-04-28 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Initial version of query
-- v1.0.1 | 2025-05-12 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Edited source data columns based on business requirements.
-- v1.0.2 | 2025-05-28 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Added translation from True/False to Y/N for internal_transfer_y_n
-- v1.0.3 | 2025-05-29 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Remove the max timestamp logic and added run_id injection parameter
-- v1.0.4 | 2025-06-04 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Fixed probability_of_close which did not have the correct logic
--   because the BRD was using incorrect wording (opportunities/deals
--   in the data warehouse close, they don't exit)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

SELECT
  --------------------------------------
  -- metadata
  --------------------------------------
  staging.source,
  staging.business_date,
  staging.run_id,
  staging.extract_timestamp,
  staging.extract_timestamp_iso_8601,
  staging.extract_timestamp_time_zone,
  --------------------------------------
  -- identifiers
  --------------------------------------
  staging.account_id,
  reference.scd_id,
  reference.security_identifier,
  reference.issuer_identifier,
  reference.cppib_security_id,
  reference.cppib_entity_id,
  staging.source_data_id,
  reference.sentry_security_id,
  reference.sentry_issuer_id,
  reference.model_portfolio_code,
  reference.deal_id,
  reference.upstream_pipeline_number,
  --------------------------------------
  -- other reference
  --------------------------------------
  reference.security_name,
  reference.strategy,
  reference.sub_strategy,
  reference.project_name,
  reference.investment_name,
  reference.country_of_exposure,
  reference.private_vs_public,
  reference.asset_category,
  reference.seniority,
  reference.risk_rating,
  reference.investment_department_id,
  reference.investment_status,
  reference.investment_lifecycle,
  reference.sector,
  reference.maturity_date AS maturity_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- other staging
  --------------------------------------
  staging.funding_currency,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm >= 0 THEN 'Deployment'
    ELSE 'Disposition'
  END AS deployment_disposition,
  COALESCE(staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm, 0) * (COALESCE(staging.probability_of_close, 0) / 100.0) AS probability_weighted_investment_amount_local,
  staging.funded_amount,
  staging.quantity_net,
  staging.market_value,
  staging.portfolio_name,
  staging.sentry_security_type,
  staging.price_multiplier,
  staging.quantity_multiplier,
  staging.debt_factor,
  staging.model_portfolio_id,
  --------------------------------------
  -- fixed-values specified in BRD
  --------------------------------------
  CASE
    WHEN TRY_CAST(staging.expected_funding_date AS DATE)
       > TRY_CAST(staging.business_date         AS DATE)
    THEN COALESCE(staging.probability_of_close, 80)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS probability_of_close,
  'Binding' AS binding,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Net Income and Expenses'
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n IS NOT NULL THEN 'Net Purchases and Sales'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS capital_usage_component,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.internal_transfer_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Internal Transfer'
    WHEN reference.asset_category = 'Aggregate Projection Shell' THEN 'Aggregate Drawdown/Distribution Projection'
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Income Only'
    ELSE 'Investment Funding/Distribution'
  END AS transaction_cash_flow_type,
  'Y' AS send_to_treasury_y_n,
  --------------------------------------
  -- 'expected'-related fields
  --------------------------------------
  staging.expected_funding_date,
  staging.expected_trade_date,
  staging.expected_exit_price,
  staging.expected_exit_probability,
  staging.expected_exit_date,
  staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm,
  --------------------------------------
  -- will be calculated by python code
  --------------------------------------
  null AS unadjusted_exit_projection,
  --------------------------------------
  -- created by and updated by fields
  --------------------------------------
  staging.last_updated_by,
  staging.last_updated_date,
  staging.created_by_user_group,
  staging.created_by,
  staging.date_updated,
  --------------------------------------
  -- source business dates
  --------------------------------------
  staging.business_date AS staging_src_business_date,
  reference.business_date AS reference_src_business_date,
  staging.sentry_ledger_projections_src_business_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- comment and error
  --------------------------------------
  staging.comment,
  staging.error,
  --------------------------------------
  -- null on purpose (from requirements)
  --------------------------------------
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount,
  NULL AS fo_comments,
  NULL AS pec_recusals,
  NULL AS pec_pipeline_y_n,
  NULL AS fx_spot,
  NULL AS full_amt_cad_mm,
  NULL AS ticket_number,
  NULL AS rejected_deals_reason,
  --------------------------------------
  -- investigate these
  --------------------------------------
  -- staging.investment_program
  -- reference.investment_strategy
  -- reference.investment_group
  -- staging.tfm_inv_sub_strategy
  --------------------------------------
  -- dw-specific fields
  --------------------------------------
  CASE 
    WHEN staging.internal_transfer_y_n = 'True' THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS internal_transfer_y_n,
  staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n,
  --------------------------------------
  -- helpful debug information
  --------------------------------------
  'ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_data_warehouse_staging, ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference' AS data_sources_list,
  'n' AS ignore_y_n
  --------------------------------------
FROM
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_data_warehouse_staging staging
LEFT JOIN
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference reference
ON
  staging.security_identifier = reference.security_identifier
  AND reference.run_id = 'fbde7252-f852-4b32-8e7b-a78224c0e5b7'
WHERE
  staging.run_id = 'fbde7252-f852-4b32-8e7b-a78224c0e5b7'

SELECT "business_date", "pool_name", "account_name", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "external_reporting_dm_em", "external_reporting_region", "external_reporting_country", "external_reporting_assetmix", "business_date_string", "year_month", "is_month_end", "is_fiscalyear_end", "external_reporting_dm_em_region", "external_reporting_currency", "total_market_value_pc"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'
			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)
select * from lt_final_agg) AS "finsights_holdings_lookthrough"

				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'
			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)
select * from lt_final_agg) AS "finsights_holdings_lookthrough"

	    SELECT
	        DATE('2025-06-17')                  AS input_date,
	        MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
	    FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
	    WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-17')
	      AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
	      AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
	),
	
	listed_seg_mp AS (
	    SELECT business_date, 
	           model_portfolio,
	           model_portfolio_name 
	    FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten 
	    WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
	      AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
	      AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
	      AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
	      AND (
	                  InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
	              AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
	              AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
	              AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
	              AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
	              AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
	               OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
	            )
	      AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
	            SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates 
	            UNION 
	            SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
	          )
	),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE 
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates) 
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency 
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE 
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates) 
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency 
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE 
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates) 
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency 
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE 
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates) 
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency 
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates

                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates

                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,

        	perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency  AS "Total PnL QC",
        	perf_data.market_value_pc_start							AS "Total Market Value PC Start",
        	perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow PC",
        	perf_data.market_value_pc_end							AS "Total Market Value PC End",
            perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
        	perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
        FROM perf_data
        INNER JOIN performance.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
                ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio 
               AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
               AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-06-17')
        ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 perf_data.bloomberg_code

	join reference.scd_model_portfolio mp on mp.model_portfolio_id = shm.model_portfolio_id

    GROUP BY mp.model_portfolio_id, ss.abor_security_name_id, asi.isin , shm.abor_maturity_date, ss.abor_security_group_id,asi.cusip

     regexp_replace(asi.bloomberg_cd, ' [^ ]*$', '') as SECURITIES_BLOOMBERGCODE,   max(asi.isin) SECURITIES_ISIN, 
    max(asi.bloomberg_unique_id) SECIDS_BBUNIQUE, 
    max(ss.abor_instrument_type_id) as SECURITIES_INSTYPE, 
    max(ss.abor_security_name_id) as SECURITIES_SECNAME, sum(shm.balance_nominal_number) as PFCHOLDINGS_BALNOMVAL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP as LAST_UPDATE_TIME 
    from reference.scd_securities ss
    join holdings.scd_holdings_main shm on shm.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number and ss.business_date = shm.business_date 
    left join asset.asset_security_identifiers asi on asi.cppib_sec_id = cast(shm.cppib_sec_id as int) and ss.business_date=cast(asi.business_date as varchar)
    join reference.scd_model_portfolio mp on mp.model_portfolio_id = shm.model_portfolio_id and mp.business_date = shm.business_date
    where shm.business_date = '2025-06-17' 
    and ss.business_date = shm.business_date 
    and TO_DATE(shm.business_date,'yyyy-mm-dd') = asi.business_date
    AND ss.abor_instrument_type_id in ('GDR/ADR', 'Equity', 'Warrant', 'Right')
	and (mp.investment_department_sub_group_responsibility_code not in ('EPM')
	or mp.model_portfolio_id in ('EPMHCRS','EPMCVSL','EPMDSPA','EPMFTPC','EPMMYAT','EPMNKTF','EPMBNPN','EPMSERK','EPMCVG2','EPMDSPI','EPMFTLB','EPMNKTD','EPMCVLD','EPMCVLG','EPMCVLR','EPMSERC'))
    group by mp.model_portfolio_id , asi.bloomberg_cd
    order by mp.model_portfolio_id , asi.bloomberg_cd

FROM (SELECT
    COALESCE(eu."party_name", '') AS "party_name",
    eu."cppib_party_id" AS "cppib_party_id",
    COALESCE(CAST(eu."cppib_party_id" AS VARCHAR), '') AS "cppib_party_id_str",

    COALESCE(eu."bloomberg_company_id", '') AS "bloomberg_company_id",

    COALESCE(eu."legal_entity_name", '') AS "legal_entity_name",

    COALESCE(eu."cppib_sector_classification_name_4", '') AS "cppib_sector_classification_name_4",
    CASE
        WHEN eu."has_securities" = 1 THEN 'YES'
        ELSE 'NO'
    END AS "has_securities_flag",
    COALESCE(child_flags.has_children, 'NO') AS has_children,
    CASE
        WHEN eu."parent_cppib_party_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES'
        ELSE 'NO'
    END AS has_parent,

    -- Now lowercase split parts
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 1))  AS party_name_word1,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 2))  AS party_name_word2,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 3))  AS party_name_word3,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 4))  AS party_name_word4,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 5))  AS party_name_word5,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 6))  AS party_name_word6,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 7))  AS party_name_word7,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 8))  AS party_name_word8,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 9))  AS party_name_word9,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 10)) AS party_name_word10,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 11)) AS party_name_word11,

    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 13)) AS party_name_word13,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 14)) AS party_name_word14,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 15)) AS party_name_word15

FROM legal_dc_dev.entities_universe eu

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        parent_cppib_party_id,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'YES'
            ELSE 'NO'
        END AS has_children
    FROM legal_dc_dev.entities_universe
    GROUP BY parent_cppib_party_id
) AS child_flags
ON eu.cppib_party_id = child_flags.parent_cppib_party_id
) AS "entities_universe"
